FEAT-2-S111.title: Implement Core Specialty Identification Logic
FEAT-2-S111.description: Implement orchestration of regex matching, vector similarity, and query expansion within specialty_service to map user input to NUCC codes with deduplication and confidence scoring.

FEAT-2-S112.description: Register specialty identification as an allowed tool in the tool_router, ensuring validated inputs are routed and outputs returned in tool_use format for LLM orchestration.

FEAT-2-S113.title: Test Specialty Identification Accuracy and Fallbacks
FEAT-2-S113.description: Create unit and integration tests validating regex matches, vector fallback behavior, NUCC code mapping accuracy, and deduplication across ambiguous user inputs.
